system.name: INFACT
system.one_liner: A diagnostic benchmark of 9,800 video QA instances with taxonomies for faithfulness and factuality hallucinations of Video-LLMs, tested in clean and induced modes.

content.variant_note: two dashed family containers (faithfulness, factuality) each stacking three category rows made of a tinted label band, a four-frame video strip and a multiple-choice question card
content.argues: The benchmark covers two families of hallucination, six categories in all, each tested by video-grounded multiple-choice items with a known correct answer.
content.subject: six benchmark categories shown by one real item each: video frames, question, options and the correct option highlighted

elements.name: Faithfulness Hallucination
elements.role: family of items verified by video evidence
elements.drawn_as: heavy green dashed rounded container with a large green title, holding three rows

elements.name: Static Entities & Attributes
elements.role: category: objects and their attributes, e.g. the colour of the second object to enter
elements.drawn_as: pale green label band at the left of its row

elements.name: Dynamics Actions & Motions
elements.role: category: actions and motions, e.g. the direction a merry-go-round turns
elements.drawn_as: pale green label band at the left of its row

elements.name: Spatial Temporal Structure
elements.role: category: spatio-temporal relations, e.g. the chronological order of a person's events
elements.drawn_as: darker green label band at the left of its row

elements.name: Factuality Hallucination
elements.role: family of items that need consistency with world knowledge
elements.drawn_as: heavy orange dashed rounded container with a large orange title, holding three rows

elements.name: Domain Knowledge
elements.role: category: facts about a domain, e.g. when a festival is celebrated (Know-WHAT in the caption)
elements.drawn_as: cream label band at the left of its row

elements.name: Procedural Knowledge
elements.role: category: whether the steps of a task are in a logical order (Know-HOW in the caption)
elements.drawn_as: light orange label band at the left of its row

elements.name: Physics Knowledge
elements.role: category: physical plausibility of events (Know-WHY in the caption)
elements.drawn_as: salmon label band at the left of its row

summary: INFACT is a diagnostic benchmark of 9,800 QA instances that probes hallucinations in video LLMs, with fine-grained taxonomies for faithfulness (contradicting the video) and factuality (contradicting world knowledge), on real and synthetic videos. Figure 1 is an example gallery. Two dashed rounded containers, green for Faithfulness Hallucination and orange for Factuality Hallucination, each hold three aligned rows. A row has a tinted category band (Static Entities & Attributes, Dynamics Actions & Motions, Spatial Temporal Structure; Domain, Procedural and Physics Knowledge), a strip of four video frames and a question card with options, the correct one highlighted in the family colour.
summary_zh: INFACT 是评测视频大模型幻觉的基准。图一做成示例画廊：绿色和橙色两个虚线容器分别代表忠实性与事实性幻觉，各含三行，每行由类别色带、四帧视频条和带高亮正确选项的选择题卡片组成。
